contract: Thematic source notes drawn from credited institutions and distributors; not evidence of full-film viewing, literary close reading, or production of a new playable story. All film_analysis statuses stay not_reviewed.

source_claims: The dystopian satire centers a bureaucratic system where an administrative error generates serious consequences for an individual.
The film contrasts the apparatus' impersonal procedures with the subjective experience of the person caught inside them.
film_form_notes: The design of bureaucratic process itself can create suspense and uncertainty, but an explicitly fantastical dystopia is not a realistic Norwegian welfare model.
An information mismatch should have an evidence trail and an unresolved decision until actual human review.
entries.original_civication_conflict: An unemployed person has a real deadline for submitting a missing weekly-hours document; a portal receipt shows what was delivered but cannot prove that an agency has decided the case.
legitimate_choices: Upload the identified document through the actual channel and keep the receipt while waiting for review.
Ask the office exactly which document is needed and record that the deadline remains unless formally extended.
If contact fails, make a separate dated follow-up attempt rather than pretending a call succeeded.
entries.persistent_consequence: A sent and acknowledged document, an unanswered inquiry, and a formal decision remain three distinct states across the next playable days.
avoid: Never depict Norwegian NAV as the authoritarian dystopia in Brazil or transfer the film's wrongful-arrest plot.
A recorded submission must never automatically approve benefits or invent a penalty, sanction, appeal or medical outcome.

source_claims: The film depicts three people who barely know one another attempting to make a home and belonging in a new community amid unsettled obligations.
Day-to-day work and relationships carry questions of trust and safety; those concerns should not be flattened into automatic membership or entitlement.
film_form_notes: Belonging is a process established through bounded commitments rather than a permanent identity granted by a single invitation.
An apparently welcoming environment can introduce new expectations, but a character still has legitimate choices and boundaries.
entries.original_civication_conflict: Arvid invites the player to an open neighborhood cultural night; a later request for a three-hour information-desk shift must not be treated as acceptance merely because the player asked for details.
legitimate_choices: Ask for the time and entry without committing to volunteer work.
Accept just one stated hour and keep the remaining two explicitly unassigned.
Decline a shift but remain welcome to attend as a guest; if an agreed shift is later canceled, notify the organizer before it starts.
entries.persistent_consequence: The difference between invited guest, confirmed one-hour duty and declined or canceled duty is saved and used by later scenes.
avoid: Do not transplant the Tamil refugee characters, civil-war history, fabricated family, gang violence or combat scenes into Arvid's social milieu.
Do not imply ethnic origin, refugee background, criminality or trauma based on a subcultural character's association with a film.

source_claims: An offer of community shelter becomes an increasingly unequal exchange of help and obligations, illustrating how vaguely negotiated reciprocity can be abused.
The unusually sparse theatrical stage design directs attention to social bargaining, visibility, and the unequal distribution of power.
film_form_notes: A change in terms can reveal hierarchy more effectively than a surprise reversal or a predetermined villain.
A community can produce genuine help and coercive expectations; the player's response should depend on observable agreement terms.
entries.original_civication_conflict: A community contact offers temporary access to a rehearsal room, then proposes an additional unpaid shift as a return favor; terms and decision authority have not yet been agreed.
legitimate_choices: Ask what was explicitly promised when the room was borrowed and separate that from a new request.
Offer a limited voluntary shift with a clear maximum or decline with reasonable notice.
Escalate a disagreement about venue access to the authorized coordinator without claiming to own the venue.
entries.persistent_consequence: Borrowed-room permission, volunteered work, the venue coordinator's decision and any unresolved favor expectation require separately persisted facts.
avoid: Do not reproduce exploitation, sexual violence, revenge, Grace's flight or the film's narrative progression.
